_about: 30-day topic calendar from the research subagent (Oct 2026). The daily routine takes the first topic whose day has no reels/day-NNN.json yet. 'misconception' = the wrong explanation the script must avoid.

topics.hook: Hammer vs feather: which lands first?
topics.aha: With no air, they land together. Apollo 15's David Scott did it on the Moon in 1971.

topics.hook: A fired bullet vs a dropped bullet: which lands first?
topics.aha: Both at the same time (ignoring air): sideways speed doesn't change how fast you fall.

topics.hook: Why doesn't ice sink?
topics.aha: Hydrogen bonds lock ice into an open hexagonal lattice about 9% less dense than liquid water.

topics.hook: Why isn't the sky white?
topics.aha: Air scatters short (blue) wavelengths far more than red: Rayleigh scattering goes as 1/wavelength^4.
topics.misconception: It is not a reflection of the ocean. Not violet because the Sun emits less violet and our eyes are less sensitive to it.

topics.hook: Where did the blue go at sunset?
topics.aha: At sunset light crosses much more air, so the blue is scattered away before it reaches you.

topics.hook: Why does a pressure cooker cook faster?
topics.aha: Higher pressure raises water's boiling point to about 120 C.

topics.hook: Rainbows are actually circles.
topics.aha: Light returns at about 42 degrees around the point opposite the Sun; the ground hides the lower half.

topics.hook: Explosions in space are silent.
topics.aha: Sound needs a medium. In a near-vacuum there are no molecules to pass it along.

topics.hook: Count the seconds to find the lightning.
topics.aha: Sound travels about 343 m/s; light is almost instant. Every 3 s of delay is roughly 1 km.

topics.hook: Why does a siren change pitch as it passes?
topics.aha: Wavefronts bunch up in front of a moving source and stretch out behind it.

topics.hook: Same temperature, so why does metal feel colder?
topics.aha: Metal conducts heat away from your hand faster; both are at room temperature.

topics.hook: Water boils at about 70 C on Everest.
topics.aha: Lower air pressure means a lower boiling point.

topics.hook: The ISS has about 90% of Earth's gravity.
topics.aha: Astronauts float because they are in continuous free fall.

topics.hook: The Moon is falling right now.
topics.aha: It keeps falling toward Earth but moves sideways fast enough to keep missing.

topics.hook: Earth is closest to the Sun in January.
topics.aha: Seasons come from Earth's 23.4 degree tilt, not its distance from the Sun.

topics.hook: Why do we only ever see one side of the Moon?
topics.aha: It is tidally locked: it spins exactly once per orbit.

topics.hook: You are seeing the Sun's past.
topics.aha: Sunlight takes about 8 min 20 s to reach Earth.

topics.hook: Electrons in a wire are slower than a snail.
topics.aha: Drift speed is under 1 mm/s, but the electric field (the signal) travels at a large fraction of light speed.
topics.misconception: Electrons do not flow at light speed.

topics.hook: Why don't birds on power lines get shocked?
topics.aha: There is almost no voltage difference between their feet, so negligible current flows.

topics.hook: Cut a magnet in half and you get...?
topics.aha: Two smaller magnets. No magnetic monopole has ever been observed.

topics.hook: Why does this magnet fall in slow motion?
topics.aha: The moving magnet induces eddy currents whose field opposes it (Lenz's law).

topics.hook: Why do skaters spin faster when they pull in their arms?
topics.aha: Angular momentum is conserved: pull mass inward and the spin rate rises.

topics.hook: Why don't the plates move?
topics.aha: Inertia: a fast pull gives friction too little time to move them.

topics.hook: Raindrops are not teardrop-shaped.
topics.aha: Small drops are spheres; bigger ones flatten into a bun shape as they fall.
topics.misconception: The teardrop shape is a myth.

topics.hook: Particles can pass through walls.
topics.aha: There is a probability of crossing a barrier, and it helps the Sun fuse hydrogen.

topics.hook: One electron, two slits?
topics.aha: Single electrons, one at a time, build up an interference pattern.
topics.misconception: It is not consciousness: any which-path measurement destroys the pattern.

topics.topic: If the Sun became a black hole
topics.hook: What if the Sun turned into a black hole?
topics.aha: Earth's orbit would not change, because the mass is the same. Only light and heat would vanish.

topics.hook: GPS would be wrong without Einstein.
topics.aha: Satellite clocks gain about 38 microseconds a day; uncorrected, positions would drift by kilometres a day.

topics.hook: Can an open fridge cool your room?
topics.aha: No, it warms it: the motor's heat is dumped into the same room.

topics.hook: You are mostly empty space?
topics.aha: A nucleus is about 100,000 times smaller than its atom; the rest is electron probability clouds, not true emptiness.

accuracy_rules: Lift is not only Bernoulli/equal transit time; wings turn air downward and pressure differences come with that.
Glass is an amorphous solid; old windows are thick at the bottom from manufacturing, not flow.
Astronauts are in free fall, not zero gravity.
Seasons come from tilt, not distance.
The sky is not blue from ocean reflection.
Coriolis does not set toilet drain direction.
Heavier objects do not fall faster in a vacuum.
Quantum observation is not about consciousness; entanglement cannot send information faster than light.
Mpemba effect is contested: avoid or present as debated.
Electrons do not flow at light speed; the field/signal does.
Centrifugal force is fictitious; say inertia in the inertial frame.
Say 'about' for rounded numbers and keep conditions (343 m/s at 20 C).
